camel_example: aliyun ims ListServiceCredentials --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken EXAMPLE0000000 --ServiceName 'xxx.aliyuncs.com' --MaxResults 20 --UserPrincipalName 'test@example.onaliyun.com' --AllUsers true
description_en: Retrieves the list of service credentials for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user or all RAM users under an Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取RAM用户或阿里云账号（主账号）下所有RAM用户的服务凭证列表
kebab_example: aliyun ims list-service-credentials --all-users true --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --service-name xxx.aliyuncs.com --max-results 20 --next-token EXAMPLE0000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceCredentials

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query service credentials for all Resource Access Management (RAM) users under the Alibaba Cloud account.

If this parameter is set to true, you cannot specify UserPrincipalName at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询云账号下所有RAM用户的服务凭证。

值为true时，不能同时指定UserPrincipalName
parameters.name: all_users

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Queries the service credentials of the specified RAM user
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户登录名称。

查询指定RAM用户的服务凭证
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en: The service name of the Alibaba Cloud service
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。
取值范围1~100，默认值10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first API call
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。
首次调用 API 不需要该字段
parameters.name: next_token
